architecture: v9 31-feature base with tuned XGBoost HPs, plus a uniform neighbor-selection rule that replaces GA-Tris special-casing: delta-train neighborhood Kt=8, candidate pool Kq_max=10, similarity threshold s>=0.6 (floor of 1 neighbor), similarity-power weighting wp=4, blend α=0.05. GA-Tris now uses the same code path as every other family. The similarity threshold makes the effective K query-dependent: tight families naturally use fewer, more-similar neighbors; loose families fall back to top-1. Zero family-specific logic in the wrapper.

changes_from_v9.architectural_uniformity: v9 had a special if-branch for GA-Tris routing to v5.2 hierarchy. v9.1 removes that; all 5 families use the same prediction path.
